data.spiritual_significance: Biblically, the term ‘xenos’ is used to represent the concept of strangers or foreigners becoming part of God's household (Galatians 6:10). Spiritually, the name "Welbie" can serve as a reminder of God's willingness to welcome all people into His kingdom, regardless of their ethnic or cultural background. It also underscores the importance of kindness, compassion, and hospitality towards others, regardless of their perceived differences.
